mintAuthority.summary: HONEY is minted only by the Berachain HoneyFactory against whitelisted collateral vaults. Both the HONEY token and HoneyFactory are UUPS proxies, and the same 3/5 Berachain Safe holds DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE for immediate upgrades and HoneyFactory parameter administration.

controls.label: HoneyFactory mint hub
controls.capDescription: HONEY mints only when whitelisted stablecoin collateral is deposited through the HoneyFactory into per-asset vaults; Basket Mode restricts mint/redeem when a collateral asset depegs.
controls.evidence: At Berachain block 23484618, HoneyFactory's implementation slot resolved to 0x6331f0a4e0220a14be27bd31af091f0a1ac036a1 while its proxy-admin and beacon slots were zero. Verified VaultAdmin source authorizes UUPS upgrades through DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, which the reviewed Safe still held.

controls.label: Berachain HoneyFactory admin (3/5 Safe)
controls.evidence: At Berachain block 23484618, getOwners() returned the same five owners, getThreshold() returned 3, getModulesPaginated() returned no modules, VERSION() returned 1.3.0, the guard slot was zero, and the fallback-handler slot remained 0xf48f2b2d2a534e402487b3ee7c18c33aec0fe5e4. hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, Safe) returned true on both the HONEY token and HoneyFactory.

review.evidence: At Berachain block 23484618, HONEY and HoneyFactory were UUPS proxies with implementations 0x96b1a552... and 0x6331f0a4..., zero proxy-admin and beacon slots, and implementations returning the standard proxiable UUID. Verified HONEY source permits mint/burn only from factory() 0xa4afef88... and authorizes upgrades through DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE. The same unchanged 3/5 Safe held that role on both proxies with no enabled modules or guard. Economic-posture fields reviewed 2026-08-15: the undelayed admin Safe can replace mint logic, and the single-chain factory vault feed continuously covers the collateral-gated mint path without named prudential supervision.
